## About
Broadway Terrace Nursery is an established Oakland business in the Rockridge neighborhood. We offer a wide selection of outdoor plants, hand picked house plants, and custom plant designs to the Oakland Hills neighborhoods.
Outside you'll find everything from perennials and annuals to shrubs, trees and succulents. Our indoor shop has houseplants and pottery, and making custom succulent and plant designs is our specialty.
BTN is a woman run and owned business. We want to be on team nature, so we source plant material from local growers, carry pottery from local artists, and promote native plants and drought tolerant options.

## Services
- Outdoor plants: A wide selection for gardens and yards in the Oakland Hills, including native plants and drought tolerant options.
- Perennials, annuals, shrubs, trees and succulents: A full scale nursery, from small starts to trees.
- Houseplants and pottery: Our indoor shop, stocked with hand picked houseplants and pottery, including pieces from local artists.
- Custom succulent and plant designs: Living arrangements made here in the shop. One reviewer called our succulent arrangements rather beautiful.
- Biodegradable pots: A line of pots that break down, and we keep looking for vendors who put the environment first.
- 50% off section: Plants that would have otherwise been composted, ready for a new home.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open every day, 10:00 AM to 5:30 PM.

Q: Are you open on holidays?
A: We are closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day, and open all other days of the year. On a few holidays we close early, so give us a call before you head over.

Q: Can I return a houseplant?
A: Houseplants can be returned within 7 days with your money back, as long as the plant is in the same condition as when you bought it.

Q: Do you deliver?
A: One customer mentioned that we deliver if it fits in our van. Give us a call to ask about your order.

Q: Is there parking?
A: Yes, there's a lot, and we're happy to help you carry things out to your car.
